primary_revenue_driver.title: Top Revenue Contributor
primary_revenue_driver.description: Wireless Keyboard is the business's leading revenue driver, generating $37,899.14 across 36 months (24.06% of total revenue). Maintaining stock availability for this high-velocity item is essential.

historical_growth.title: Multi-Year Sales Momentum
historical_growth.description: Annual revenue expanded by 21.7% from the initial 12-month period ($47,694.23) to the final 12-month period ($58,021.58). This indicates sustainable, steady commercial growth across product lines.

seasonality_pattern.title: Seasonal Demand Variations
seasonality_pattern.description: Sales exhibit strong seasonality, peaking in 2025-11 at $6,469.77 during Q4 holiday commercial cycles. The lowest recorded volume occurred in 2023-02 ($3,124.31), reflecting standard post-holiday retail lulls.

forecast_outlook.title: Three-Month Revenue Projection
forecast_outlook.model_used: Holt-Winters Exponential Smoothing (Base R stats, 95% PI)
forecast_outlook.description: Projected revenue for the next 3 months (2026-01 to 2026-03) is estimated at $14,068.99 (95% prediction interval: $12,139.57 – $15,998.42). Holdout testing yielded a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 7.2%.

actionable_recommendations: Align inventory restocking for the top product ('Wireless Keyboard') 4 to 6 weeks before anticipated demand surges.
Buffer working capital during Q1 to absorb predictable post-holiday seasonal dips observed in January and February.
Consider bundling slower-moving catalogue items like 'Desk Mat' with high-velocity accessories to lift average order value.
